integrity: The general argument is a direct finite-poset proof; the reproducible enumerator independently checks finite cases and does not purport to establish the infinite-parametric theorem. Literary priority and external auditing remain open.
scientific_limitations: The cubical-fiber theorem applies to finite antisymmetric preorders (T0 Alexandrov spaces). The entropy formula assumes independent identically distributed Bernoulli membership. No claim about the entire output count from the strict-upper-degree profile, infinite posets, or arbitrary correlated sources.
title: Boolean fibers and exact entropy of finite Alexandrov rough observations
